quality_assessment: Chapter is comprehensive and well-written with accurate flag documentation and excellent examples. Main gaps are advanced flags (JSON output, debugging, regex engine selection) and binary file handling. Content is accurate but incomplete for advanced users.

issues.description: Missing documentation for multiline pattern matching flags
issues.should_add: Document -U/--multiline flag for patterns spanning multiple lines and --multiline-dotall for dot matching newlines
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on multiline mode with examples of patterns spanning lines. Explain difference between -U alone and with --multiline-dotall. Show practical examples like matching function definitions across lines.

issues.description: Missing documentation for PCRE2 regex engine support
issues.should_add: Document -P/--pcre2 flag for switching to PCRE2 engine with advanced features (backreferences, lookahead/lookbehind)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on regex engines. Explain default Rust regex vs PCRE2. Show examples requiring PCRE2 like lookahead: rg -P 'foo(?=bar)' or backreferences: rg -P '(\w+)\s+\1'

issues.description: Missing documentation for regex engine selection
issues.should_add: Document --engine flag for choosing between default and PCRE2 engines
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about --engine flag allowing explicit engine choice (auto, default, pcre2). Mention this provides control over which regex backend to use.

issues.description: Missing documentation for JSON output mode
issues.should_add: Document --json flag for structured JSON Lines output format with message types (begin, match, context, end, summary)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on JSON output mode. Explain JSON Lines format, message types, use cases (machine parsing, tooling integration). Show example JSON match object with fields like path, line_number, submatches, etc. Reference features.json:57-61 for complete schema.

issues.description: Missing documentation for vimgrep output format
issues.should_add: Document --vimgrep flag for vim-compatible quickfix format useful for IDE integration
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about --vimgrep output format. Explain it produces vim-compatible quickfix output (path:line:col:text) useful for editor integration and tooling.

issues.description: Missing documentation for heading mode control
issues.should_add: Document --heading and --no-heading flags for controlling grouped output by file
issues.fix_suggestion: Add explanation of heading mode. --heading groups matches by file with filename as header. --no-heading shows inline format (path:line:match). Note that -p flag enables heading mode. Show visual examples of both formats.
issues.source_reference: features.json:177 (pretty flag mentions --heading), features.json:261 (standard printer features include heading mode)

issues.description: Missing documentation for byte offset display
issues.should_add: Document -b/--byte-offset flag for showing absolute file byte offsets
issues.fix_suggestion: Add -b/--byte-offset flag. Shows absolute byte offset in file for each match. Useful for binary file analysis and precise location tracking. Example output: file.txt:42:137:matching line (137 is byte offset).

issues.should_add: Document --hyperlink-format flag for clickable terminal links using OSC 8 escape sequences
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on hyperlinks. Explain --hyperlink-format with built-in aliases (vscode, cursor, macvim, etc.) and custom format strings. Show variable interpolation: {path}, {line}, {column}. Example: rg --hyperlink-format vscode pattern. Note requires terminal with OSC 8 support.

issues.description: Missing documentation for binary file handling
issues.should_add: Document --binary and -a/--text flags for controlling binary file search behavior
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on binary files. Explain ripgrep auto-detects binary files (via NUL byte) and skips them. --binary forces searching binary files. -a/--text treats all files as text. Mention --max-columns-preview for binary detection tuning.

issues.description: Missing documentation for advanced filtering options
issues.should_add: Document --same-file-system flag and parent directory ignore file behavior
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about --same-file-system to avoid crossing filesystem boundaries. Mention parent directory traversal respects parent .gitignore/.ignore files by default.

issues.should_add: Document --sort and --sortr flags with sorting criteria (path, modified, accessed, created)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on sorting. Explain --sort SORTBY and --sortr SORTBY (reverse). Available criteria: path (default), modified, accessed, created. Note: requires buffering all results which impacts performance. Examples: rg --sort modified pattern, rg --sortr path pattern.

issues.description: Missing documentation for line length limits
issues.should_add: Document --max-columns and --max-columns-preview flags for handling long lines
issues.fix_suggestion: Add --max-columns NUM to truncate/skip long lines for performance. Add --max-columns-preview NUM for binary detection threshold. Explain long lines can slow down search and these flags help manage that.

issues.description: Missing documentation for debugging and statistics flags
issues.should_add: Document --debug, --trace, and --stats flags for troubleshooting and performance analysis
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on debugging. --debug shows search strategy, engine selection, config. --trace shows trace-level debug info. --stats shows metrics (elapsed time, bytes searched, matches, etc). Useful for understanding performance and troubleshooting pattern issues.

issues.description: Missing documentation for custom color configuration
issues.should_add: Document --colors flag for fine-grained color customization beyond --color
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about --colors TYPE:STYLE:VALUE for customizing specific color types (path, line, column, match, highlight). Supports standard 16, 256-color palette, and 24-bit RGB. Can specify bold, intense, underline, italic. Example: rg --colors 'match:fg:red' --colors 'path:style:bold' pattern.

issues.should_add: Document --path-separator flag for controlling path separator in output
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief mention of --path-separator for customizing path separators in output (useful for Windows/Unix compatibility).
issues.source_reference: Implied by output formatting capabilities, common in cross-platform tools

issues.should_add: Document --pcre2-version flag for checking PCRE2 availability and JIT status
issues.fix_suggestion: Add --pcre2-version to show PCRE2 library version and whether JIT compilation is available. Useful for verifying PCRE2 support before using -P flag.

issues.section: File Filtering > Hidden Files and Symlinks
issues.description: Chapter documents --hidden with alias -. but features.json doesn't confirm this alias
issues.should_verify: Verify if -. is actually an alias for --hidden or if this is documentation drift
issues.fix_suggestion: Check ripgrep source code or --help output to confirm -. alias. If not supported, update to just --hidden. If supported, this is fine.

issues.description: Explanation of -uuu could be more specific about what 'don't filter out anything' means
issues.should_be: -uuu: Disable all filtering including respect for ignore files, hidden files, and binary detection
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify that -uuu combines all unrestricted behaviors: searches ignored files (.gitignore), hidden files, and doesn't skip binary files. It's the most permissive mode.
issues.source_reference: features.json:235-254 (file filtering hierarchy and binary detection)

Every flag includes clear, practical examples with real command lines
Good progressive complexity from simple to advanced features
Helpful Quick Reference table for essential flags
Excellent Comparison with grep section for users transitioning
Combining Flags section shows real-world usage patterns
Good use of bash syntax highlighting in code blocks
Clear explanation of smart case behavior with concrete examples
Context lines section includes helpful note about -- separator
See Also section provides good navigation to related chapters
